concerns.location: tasks.md:Dependencies and requirement coverage — Execution order
concerns.text: Execution order states 'T009 → (T010, T011) → T012' i.e. T010 and T011 run in parallel, yet the same section says 'T011's sensitivity figure depends on T010' (figures/sensitivity_sweep.png is derived from data/results/sensitivity_sweep.json produced by T010). Running them in parallel would have T011 read an artifact T010 has not yet emitted. Either serialize T010 → T011 or split T011 so only the sensitivity figure waits for T010.

T007 is tagged [P] and scheduled after T006, but its 30-sample threshold calibration needs model reasoning strings — it does not state whether calibration uses T004 pilot outputs or T006 full outputs. If T007 is intended to run in parallel with anything (the [P] tag implies so), the input artifact must be pinned (e.g. data/results/pilot_outputs.jsonl from T004) to keep the parallel grouping well-defined.
